raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.2.5" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-ife
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/ife_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/ife/ife_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7c8b34846b6cfda48ba0027b1c5b6f95caf58e2a24d047f2a1cbcbe789011565

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-s7 >=0.2.0
    - r-cli
    - r-collapse
    - r-generics
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-s7 >=0.2.0
    - r-cli
    - r-collapse
    - r-generics

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('ife')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('ife')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=ife
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  summary: Implements an S7 class for estimates based on influence functions, with forward mode automatic differentiation defined for standard arithmetic operations.
  license_family: GPL3
  license_file:
    - '{{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3'

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
